clips.title: The story
paras: Murlocs are spreading through eastern Elwynn, and the Stormwind Army has put a bounty on them. With the garrison stretched thin, Guard Thomas turns to travelers to clear the shoreline camps around Stone Cairn Lake and the southern waterways before the murlocs overrun nearby farms and roads.

Murlocs have made shoreline camps around Stone Cairn Lake and along the fork of the southern streams. Lurkers and foragers now attack travelers and press toward human settlements. What began as a minor nuisance has grown into a threat across eastern Elwynn, while the western roads remain comparatively secure.

Guard Thomas is stationed at the eastern bridge beside the Redridge Mountains, where dangers beyond the bridge and disorder at home compete for his attention. King Varian Wrynn is missing, and Stormwind's military command is mired in bureaucracy. Town garrisons rarely get the reinforcements they request. Marshal Dughan and local officers have turned to public bounties, offering coin for murloc fins to slow the attacks along the waterways.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Stormwind Army has placed a bounty on murloc lurkers and foragers in Elwynn. Slaughter them and bring me their torn murloc fins, and the Stormwind Army will reward you well.
The murlocs have built a village at Stone Cairn Lake north of here, and another to the south where the stream forks.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have the fins? Great! Marshal Dughan is anxious about the Murloc situation in eastern Elwynn, and I'd like to tell him that it's becoming under control.
Your actions have helped realize that.
